tableDescriptions.inventory.item__t: Individual physical or electronic item records (barcodes, status, call number, material type, loan type). Each item belongs to a holdings_record.
tableDescriptions.inventory.holdings_record__t: Holdings records linking instances to locations. Contains shelving info, call numbers, and location assignments.
tableDescriptions.inventory.instance__t: Bibliographic instance records (title, contributors, identifiers, publication info). The top-level catalog entity.
tableDescriptions.inventory.loccampus__t: Campus locations in the library consortium (e.g. Smith College, Amherst College, Hampshire College). Represents institutional campuses — NOT vendors or organizations.
tableDescriptions.inventory.locinstitution__t: Top-level institutional entities in the location hierarchy (e.g. Five Colleges consortium).
tableDescriptions.inventory.loclibrary__t: Library locations within a campus (e.g. Young Science Library, Neilson Library). Child of loccampus.
tableDescriptions.inventory.location__t: Specific shelving/storage locations within a library (e.g. Main Stacks, Reserve Desk). Lowest level of location hierarchy.
tableDescriptions.inventory.material_type__t: Material type definitions (book, DVD, serial, sound recording, microform, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.loan_type__t: Loan type/circulation rule definitions (Can circulate, Course reserves, Non-circulating, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.instance_type__t: Resource type definitions for instances (text, cartographic image, performed music, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.instance_status__t: Cataloging status for instances (cataloged, uncataloged, batch loaded, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.instance_format__t: Physical format of instances (volume, microfilm, online resource, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.holdings_type__t: Holdings type definitions (physical, electronic, monograph, serial, multi-part monograph).
tableDescriptions.inventory.call_number_type__t: Call number classification schemes (Library of Congress, Dewey Decimal, SuDoc, NLM, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.service_point__t: Service desks/points where circulation transactions occur (e.g. Circ Desk, ILL Office).
tableDescriptions.inventory.classification_type__t: Classification system types used for instance classification (LC, Dewey, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.contributor_name_type__t: Types of contributor names (personal, corporate, meeting).
tableDescriptions.inventory.contributor_type__t: Contributor role types (author, editor, illustrator, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.identifier_type__t: Identifier type definitions (ISBN, ISSN, OCLC, LCCN, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.statistical_code__t: Statistical code values used for item/holdings/instance categorization and reporting.
tableDescriptions.inventory.statistical_code_type__t: Statistical code type definitions (ARL, DISC, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.alternative_title_type__t: Types of alternative titles (uniform title, variant title, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.electronic_access_relationship: Types of electronic access relationships (resource, version of resource, related resource, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.mode_of_issuance__t: Mode of issuance for instances (single unit, multipart monograph, serial, integrating resource).
tableDescriptions.inventory.nature_of_content_term__t: Nature of content terms (autobiography, bibliography, catalog, etc.).
tableDescriptions.inventory.holdings_note_type__t: Types of notes that can be attached to holdings records.
tableDescriptions.inventory.item_note_type__t: Types of notes that can be attached to item records.
tableDescriptions.inventory.ill_policy__t: Interlibrary loan policy definitions for holdings.
tableDescriptions.inventory.instance_note_type__t: Types of notes for instance records.
tableDescriptions.inventory.instance_relationship_type__t: Types of relationships between instances (bound-with, analytics, etc.).
tableDescriptions.circulation.loan__t: Aggregate checkout/loan records — loan dates, due dates, return dates, renewal counts. Use for circulation counts and trends only. Do NOT select user_id or any patron-identifying columns.
tableDescriptions.circulation.loan_policy__t: Loan policy definitions (loan period, renewals allowed, grace period, etc.).
tableDescriptions.circulation.fixed_due_date_schedule__t: Fixed due date schedule definitions for loan policies.
tableDescriptions.circulation.request_policy__t: Request policy definitions (hold, recall, page rules).
tableDescriptions.circulation.staff_slips__t: Staff slip template definitions (hold slip, transit slip, etc.).
tableDescriptions.orders.po_line__t: Purchase order lines — individual line items on purchase orders. Contains material type, cost, fund, physical/electronic details.
tableDescriptions.orders.purchase_order__t: Purchase orders (POs) — the top-level order record. Links to vendor organization. Contains order date, workflow status.
tableDescriptions.orders.pieces__t: Individual pieces expected/received for a purchase order line.
tableDescriptions.orders.order_invoice_relationship__t: Links between purchase orders and invoices.
tableDescriptions.orders.acquisitions_unit__t: Acquisitions unit definitions (organizational groupings for acquisitions workflow).
tableDescriptions.orders.order_templates__t: Templates for creating new purchase orders.
tableDescriptions.organizations.organizations__t: Vendor and supplier organizations for acquisitions and serials (e.g. EBSCO, GOBI, YBP, Harrassowitz). These are VENDORS you purchase from — NOT institutional campuses or colleges.
tableDescriptions.organizations.interfaces__t: Electronic data interchange interfaces for vendor organizations.
tableDescriptions.invoice.invoices__t: Invoice header records from vendors. Contains invoice date, vendor, status, totals.
tableDescriptions.invoice.invoice_lines__t: Individual line items on vendor invoices. Links to PO lines and fund distributions.
tableDescriptions.invoice.vouchers__t: Payment vouchers generated from approved invoices.
tableDescriptions.invoice.voucher_lines__t: Individual voucher line items with fund/expense breakdowns.
tableDescriptions.finance.fund__t: Fund definitions (library budget funds for purchasing). Each fund belongs to a ledger and fiscal year.
tableDescriptions.finance.budget__t: Budget records — allocated amounts for each fund within a fiscal year.
tableDescriptions.finance.transaction__t: Financial transactions — encumbrances, payments, credits, transfers between funds.
tableDescriptions.finance.fiscal_year__t: Fiscal year definitions (start date, end date, code).
tableDescriptions.finance.ledger__t: Ledger definitions — top-level groupings of funds.
tableDescriptions.finance.fund_type__t: Fund type definitions (e.g. Appropriation, Endowment, Gift).
tableDescriptions.finance.expense_class__t: Expense class definitions for categorizing spending (e.g. Electronic, Print, Binding).
tableDescriptions.finance.groups__t: Fund group definitions for grouping related funds.
tableDescriptions.finance.group_fund_fy__t: Links finance groups to specific funds within a fiscal year. Use this to see which funds belong to which group for a given FY. JOIN to finance.fund__t via fund_id, finance.groups__t via group_id, finance.fiscal_year__t via fiscal_year_id.
tableDescriptions.finance.ledger_roll_budget__t: Budget records created during fiscal year ledger rollover. Shows allocated, available, encumbered, and expended amounts rolled from the prior year. JOIN to finance.budget__t via budget_id, finance.ledger__t via ledger_id.
tableDescriptions.finance.fund_code_exp_cla: Pre-joined view mapping fund codes to expense classes. Useful shortcut for finance queries needing both fund and expense class names without extra JOINs.
tableDescriptions.users.groups__t: Patron group type definitions (Faculty, Undergraduate, Graduate, Staff, etc.). Use only for labeling/grouping aggregate counts — never select individual patron records.
tableDescriptions.agreements.sas__t: Subscription agreement records — tracks active, expired, and in-negotiation agreements with vendors for electronic resources. Key columns: name, agreement_status (Active/Closed/In Negotiation), start_date, end_date, cancellation_deadline. JOIN to agreements.entitlement__t via id to see which resources are covered by each agreement.
tableDescriptions.agreements.entitlement__t: Links an agreement to a specific resource (e-journal title, database, e-book package). Each row is one resource entitlement under an agreement. JOIN to agreements.sas__t via owner__id = sas__t.id. Use for queries like 'what resources are covered under this agreement'.
tableDescriptions.agreements.org__t: Organizations (vendors/publishers) linked to subscription agreements. JOIN to agreements.sas__t via owner__id.
tableDescriptions.agreements.refdata_value__t: Reference data values used by the agreements module — agreement statuses, renewal priorities, content types.
tableDescriptions.licenses.license__t: License records for electronic resources. Tracks license status, type, start/end dates, and custom properties such as ILL permissions, perpetual access rights, walk-in user access, and data mining rights. Custom property values are in subtables: licenses.license__t__custom_properties__*.
tableDescriptions.feesfines.owners__t: Fee/fine owner definitions (which service point/library owns the fee).
tableDescriptions.folio_source_record.records__t: Source bibliographic records in MARC and other formats. Contains record state, suppression status, and linkage to inventory instances via external_id (= instance UUID). Use for queries about MARC record status or batch record provenance.
tableDescriptions.courses.coursereserves_courselistings__t: Course reserve listings linking courses to terms, locations, and instructors.
tableDescriptions.courses.coursereserves_courses__t: Course records — one row per course with name, description, and a reference to its course listing. JOIN to courses.coursereserves_courselistings__t via course_listing_id for term and instructor details.
tableDescriptions.courses.coursereserves_reserves__t: Course reserve items — links a course listing to a specific inventory item placed on reserve. Contains copied item metadata and processing/copyright status. JOIN to courses.coursereserves_courselistings__t via course_listing_id, and to inventory.item__t via item_id.
tableDescriptions.courses.coursereserves_terms__t: Academic term definitions for course reserves (Fall 2025, Spring 2026, etc.).
tableDescriptions.notes.note_data__t: Notes attached to various FOLIO records.

vocabulary.college: inventory.loccampus__t.name — campuses in the consortium (Smith College, Amherst College, etc.). NOT organizations.
vocabulary.campus: inventory.loccampus__t.name — campuses in the location hierarchy.
vocabulary.institution: inventory.locinstitution__t.name — top-level institution (e.g. Five Colleges consortium).
vocabulary.library: inventory.loclibrary__t.name — libraries within a campus (e.g. Neilson Library, Young Science Library).
vocabulary.location: inventory.location__t.name — specific shelving locations within a library (e.g. Main Stacks, Reserve).
vocabulary.effective location: inventory.item__t.effective_location_id — ALWAYS use this for location joins on items, NOT permanent_location_id. The effective location reflects temporary/current location overrides.
vocabulary.item location: inventory.item__t.effective_location_id — join to inventory.location__t.id. NEVER use holdings_record__t.permanent_location_id for circulation or item-level queries.
vocabulary.inventory new tables: inventory.bound_width_parts__t tracks items physically bound together (JOIN via holdings_record_id to holdings_record__t). inventory.preceding_suceeding_titles__t tracks title changes for serials (JOIN via preceding_instance_id or succeeding_instance_id to instance__t). inventory.subject_sources__t and inventory.subject_types__t are reference tables for subject heading controlled vocabularies.
vocabulary.marc field tables: PREFERRED approach for MARC-level queries. The marctab schema contains one table per MARC field, named marctab.mt000 through marctab.mt999. These are NOT in the standard schema but can be used for MARC-level queries. Each table has: srs_id (UUID), instance_hrid (links to inventory.instance__t.hrid), field (tag), ind1, ind2, ord (occurrence), sf_a through sf_z and sf_0 through sf_9 for subfields. Common fields: marctab.mt020 (ISBN, sf_a), marctab.mt022 (ISSN, sf_a), marctab.mt050 (LC call number, sf_a+sf_b), marctab.mt082 (Dewey, sf_a), marctab.mt100 (main entry name, sf_a), marctab.mt245 (title, sf_a+sf_b), marctab.mt264 (publication, sf_a=place sf_b=publisher sf_c=date), marctab.mt650 (subject topical, sf_a+sf_2), marctab.mt700 (added entry, sf_a), marctab.mt856 (URL, sf_u). JOIN to inventory: JOIN marctab.mtNNN m ON m.instance_hrid = inst.hrid. Only query the specific marctab.mtNNN table needed, never all 1000. ALWAYS prefer marctab over parsing raw MARC JSON from folio_source_record.records__t — marctab is faster, simpler, and avoids JSONB operator issues. To check whether a MARC field EXISTS for a record, use a LEFT JOIN to the marctab.mtNNN table and check for NULL (WHERE m.srs_id IS NULL means the field is missing). To check whether a field does NOT exist, LEFT JOIN and WHERE m.srs_id IS NULL. WARNING: NEVER use the PostgreSQL ? JSONB key-exists operator — it breaks the PDO query layer. Use jsonb_exists() if raw JSON parsing is absolutely necessary.
vocabulary.agreement: agreements.sas__t — subscription agreements with vendors for electronic resources. Use agreements.entitlement__t to see which specific resources (titles, databases) are covered.
vocabulary.subscription: agreements.sas__t — subscription agreements. agreement_status column: 'Active', 'Closed', 'In Negotiation'.
vocabulary.license: licenses.license__t — license records for electronic resources. Contains custom properties for ILL terms, perpetual access, and walk-in access stored in licenses.license__t__custom_properties__* subtables.
vocabulary.perpetual access: licenses.license__t with custom property subtables for perpetual access terms.
vocabulary.course reserve: courses.coursereserves_reserves__t for items on reserve. JOIN to courses.coursereserves_courselistings__t for the course listing, then to courses.coursereserves_courses__t for the course name and courses.coursereserves_terms__t for the term.
vocabulary.isbn: marctab.mt020.sf_a — ISBN values. JOIN via instance_hrid to inventory.instance__t.hrid.
vocabulary.issn: marctab.mt022.sf_a — ISSN values. JOIN via instance_hrid to inventory.instance__t.hrid.
vocabulary.fund group: finance.group_fund_fy__t — links funds to groups within a fiscal year. JOIN to finance.fund__t via fund_id and finance.groups__t via group_id.
vocabulary.rollover: finance.ledger_roll_budget__t — fiscal year rollover budget records. Shows what was rolled from the prior fiscal year.
vocabulary.publisher: inventory.instance__t.index_title or publication fields — NOT organizations.
vocabulary.checkout: circulation.loan__t — a loan record represents a checkout. loan_date is the checkout date. Always aggregate (COUNT) — do not return individual patron data.
vocabulary.return: circulation.loan__t.return_date — the return date on a loan record.
vocabulary.purchased: orders.po_line__t — purchase order lines. Use purchase_order__t.date_ordered for purchase date.
vocabulary.ordered: orders.purchase_order__t.date_ordered — the date a purchase order was placed.
vocabulary.material type: inventory.material_type__t.name — type of material (Book, DVD, serial, etc.). Values are Title Case in the database — always use ILIKE or LOWER() for matching.
vocabulary.format: inventory.instance_format__t.name — physical format of an instance.
vocabulary.barcode: inventory.item__t.barcode — item barcode for identifying physical items.
vocabulary.title: inventory.instance__t.title — bibliographic title.
vocabulary.budget: finance.budget__t — budget allocations per fund per fiscal year.
vocabulary.invoice: invoice.invoices__t — vendor invoices. Use invoice_lines__t for line items. For campus-scoped spending, join through invoice_lines__t__fund_distributions → orders.po_line__t → orders.purchase_order__t__acq_unit_ids → orders.acquisitions_unit__t.
vocabulary.vendor spending: Campus-scoped vendor spending: start from invoice.invoice_lines__t__fund_distributions, join invoices__t for dates and vendor_id, join organizations__t for vendor name, join po_line__t → purchase_order__t__acq_unit_ids → acquisitions_unit__t for campus filter. Aggregate line-level amounts (iltfd.total * fund_distributions__value * 0.01), never invoice header totals. IMPORTANT: acquisitions_unit__t.name stores 2-letter codes (SC=Smith, AC=Amherst, MH=Mt Holyoke, UM=UMass, HC=Hampshire) — use au.name = 'SC' for Smith College, never LOWER(au.name) = LOWER('Smith College').
vocabulary.acquisitions unit: orders.acquisitions_unit__t — identifies which campus owns a purchase order. Used to campus-scope ALL finance and acquisitions queries. Join via orders.purchase_order__t__acq_unit_ids on purchase_order_id. IMPORTANT: the name column stores 2-letter abbreviation codes (SC=Smith, AC=Amherst, MH=Mt Holyoke, UM=UMass, HC=Hampshire, RP=Five Colleges, YB=Yiddish Book Center) — NOT full campus names. Always filter with au.name = 'SC' (exact match), never LOWER(au.name) = LOWER('Smith College').
vocabulary.patron group: users.groups__t.group — patron type label (Faculty, Undergraduate, Graduate, Staff). Use only as a GROUP BY label for aggregate counts.
vocabulary.circulating: circulation.loan__t — count loans to measure circulation. Join item → effective_location_id → location → loclibrary → loccampus for location context.
vocabulary.book: inventory.material_type__t where LOWER(name) = 'book'. The database stores 'Book' (capitalized). Always use case-insensitive comparison.
vocabulary.equipment: inventory.material_type__t where LOWER(name) LIKE '%equipment%'. Exclude with AND LOWER(imt.name) NOT LIKE '%equipment%'.

examples.question: How many items are currently on course reserve this semester?
examples.sql: SELECT cr_courses.name AS course_name, cr_terms.name AS term_name, COUNT(cres.id) AS items_on_reserve FROM courses.coursereserves_reserves__t AS cres JOIN courses.coursereserves_courselistings__t AS cl ON cres.course_listing_id = cl.id JOIN courses.coursereserves_courses__t AS cr_courses ON cr_courses.course_listing_id = cl.id JOIN courses.coursereserves_terms__t AS cr_terms ON cl.term_id = cr_terms.id WHERE cr_terms.name ILIKE '%Spring%2026%' GROUP BY cr_courses.name, cr_terms.name ORDER BY items_on_reserve DESC;

examples.question: Show me all materials purchased in the last 90 days grouped by material type purchased by Smith College
examples.sql: SELECT imt.name AS material_type_name, COUNT(plt.id) AS total_purchased FROM orders.po_line__t AS plt JOIN orders.purchase_order__t AS po ON plt.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN orders.purchase_order__t__acq_unit_ids AS potaui ON potaui.id = po.id JOIN orders.acquisitions_unit__t AS au ON au.id = potaui.acq_unit_ids AND au.name = 'SC' LEFT JOIN inventory.material_type__t AS imt ON imt.id = COALESCE(plt.eresource__material_type, plt.physical__material_type) WHERE po.date_ordered::date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days') GROUP BY imt.name ORDER BY total_purchased DESC;

examples.question: How many items does each library have?
examples.sql: SELECT lib.name AS library_name, COUNT(ii.id) AS item_count FROM inventory.item__t AS ii JOIN inventory.location__t AS loc ON ii.effective_location_id = loc.id JOIN inventory.loclibrary__t AS lib ON loc.library_id = lib.id GROUP BY lib.name ORDER BY item_count DESC;

examples.question: What vendors have we spent the most money with this fiscal year for Smith College?
examples.sql: SELECT org.name AS vendor_name, ROUND(SUM(iltfd.total * (iltfd.fund_distributions__value * 0.01)), 2) AS total_spent FROM invoice.invoice_lines__t__fund_distributions iltfd INNER JOIN invoice.invoices__t inv ON inv.id = iltfd.invoice_id AND inv.payment_date::date BETWEEN (SELECT period_start FROM finance.fiscal_year__t WHERE code = 'FY2026') AND (SELECT period_end FROM finance.fiscal_year__t WHERE code = 'FY2026') INNER JOIN organizations.organizations__t org ON org.id = inv.vendor_id INNER JOIN orders.po_line__t plt ON iltfd.po_line_id = plt.id INNER JOIN orders.purchase_order__t__acq_unit_ids potaui ON potaui.id = plt.purchase_order_id INNER JOIN orders.acquisitions_unit__t au ON au.id = potaui.acq_unit_ids AND au.name = 'SC' WHERE iltfd.invoice_line_status = 'Paid' GROUP BY org.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 20;

examples.question: Show me the top 10 highest circulating books from Smith College between June 2024 and June 2025
examples.sql: SELECT lib.name AS library_name, ii.effective_call_number_components__call_number AS call_number, inst.title, MAX(cl.loan_date) AS last_circulation_date, COUNT(cl.id) AS circulation_count FROM circulation.loan__t AS cl JOIN inventory.item__t AS ii ON cl.item_id = ii.id JOIN inventory.material_type__t AS imt ON ii.material_type_id = imt.id JOIN inventory.holdings_record__t AS hr ON ii.holdings_record_id = hr.id JOIN inventory.instance__t AS inst ON hr.instance_id = inst.id JOIN inventory.location__t AS loc ON ii.effective_location_id = loc.id JOIN inventory.loclibrary__t AS lib ON loc.library_id = lib.id JOIN inventory.loccampus__t AS camp ON lib.campus_id = camp.id WHERE cl.loan_date::date >= '2024-06-30' AND cl.loan_date::date <= '2025-06-30' AND LOWER(camp.name) = LOWER('Smith College') AND LOWER(imt.name) = 'book' AND LOWER(imt.name) NOT LIKE '%equipment%' GROUP BY lib.name, ii.effective_call_number_components__call_number, inst.title ORDER BY circulation_count DESC LIMIT 10;
